account_scope.configured_account: the one explicitly configured Protocol101 paper account
account_scope.dedication_requirement: the account must be declared dedicated to this Protocol101 evidence run for the entire session
account_scope.failure: block all new entries; never subtract or estimate unrelated state
account_scope.verification_source: authenticated account, position, order, execution, commission, and cash-flow snapshots joined to the immutable Protocol101 ledger
zero_external_state_required: no non-Protocol101 execution or commission event since the prior session close

live_paper_value.canonical_selection: Select the authenticated snapshot with the greatest broker source timestamp in the closed interval [09:29:00,09:30:00] America/New_York for the session date; break a source-timestamp tie only by the greatest authenticated broker update sequence.
live_paper_value.missing_stale_ambiguous_or_late: block all new entries for the session and log SESSION_START_EQUITY_UNAVAILABLE
live_paper_value.normalization: parse the broker value exactly as decimal USD, round once to nearest cent using ROUND_HALF_EVEN, and freeze the resulting integer cents for the session
live_paper_value.single_source: the selected authenticated IBKR NetLiquidation snapshot; no fallback to AvailableFunds, BuyingPower, prior-day values, estimates, or operator guesses

offline_value.later_governed_session: the policy-specific simulator cash cents immediately after the prior governed session's exact forced-flat/exit realization and all booked fee/commission events, carried unchanged to the current 09:30 boundary
offline_value.single_source: the immutable policy causal cash ledger

evidence.inside_cluster_substitute: never used as the WAIT comparator; exact-contract regret is separately constrained by the mandatory q90 regret action rule
evidence.membership: same expiry and right as the selected contract and absolute strike_milli_points difference<=10000 (plus or minus two standard 5-point ladder steps); only surviving ranked contracts may belong
evidence.outside_cluster_comparator: highest primary_rank_score among surviving contracts outside that cluster; if none survives, WAIT with score 0 is the outside comparator
evidence.selected_cluster_score: maximum primary_rank_score inside the selected contract's cluster

expected_calibration.calibrated_lower_bound: seed-ensemble predicted conditional mean plus the one-sided lower confidence correction
expected_calibration.correction: the empirical 0.10 quantile of the deterministic session-cluster bootstrap distribution of the equally weighted mean residual; add this signed correction to every same-head prediction
expected_calibration.finite_horizon_filter: the unchanged full-window filter applies before residual construction
expected_calibration.horizon_set: all causally available registered horizons including h3 and h5
expected_calibration.outcome_conformal_alias_forbidden: an individual-row residual quantile, q10 outcome bound, or conformal lower prediction interval may not be called a confidence bound on the conditional mean
expected_calibration.prediction_source: the frozen final conditional-mean gate-support heads in forecast_heads.json predicted once on the disjoint calibration sessions
expected_calibration.residual: realized unchanged fee-adjusted target minus seed-ensemble predicted conditional mean
expected_calibration.scope: one correction per metric, horizon, and unit; global across calibration phases for this amendment
expected_calibration.seed_rule: derive a deterministic uint32 bootstrap seed from SHA-256 of product_contract_hash plus the canonical head name; consumer-local seed overrides are forbidden
expected_calibration.session_cluster: average finite residual rows within each calibration session first, then weight every distinct session equally
expected_calibration.target_membership: all label-complete rows for the head; runtime composer output and model-selected membership are forbidden
expected_calibration.terminology: session-clustered lower confidence correction for expected/mean upside; not an outcome-conformal guarantee

expected_outputs.composer_role: positive-after-fee gate only; the existing calibrated-q10 favorable percentiles remain the unchanged rank statistics
expected_outputs.ensemble: median across the three seed-specific conditional-mean forecasts before the disjoint-calibration lower-confidence correction
expected_outputs.head_family: required fixed-weight gate-support companions to the existing upside family; they do not delete, replace, retune, or reweight any existing quantile head
expected_outputs.loss: masked mean squared error on the unchanged full-window fee-adjusted labels
expected_outputs.output: unbounded conditional arithmetic mean in each native fee-adjusted unit

expected_upside_gate.calibrated_lower_bound: predicted conditional mean plus the same-head one-sided 90 percent lower confidence correction for mean residual from calibration_spec.json; this is not an individual-outcome lower prediction quantile
expected_upside_gate.fee_threshold: strictly zero because every target is already fee-adjusted; equality fails
expected_upside_gate.horizon_set: every causally available registered horizon, including h3 and h5
expected_upside_gate.satisfiability_guard: the gate must reference forecast_heads.json central_tendency_entry_gate_outputs; calibrated q10, q10 aliases, and individual-outcome conformal lower bounds are forbidden gate statistics

evidence.positive_after_fee_rule: the equal-horizon mean calibrated conservative lower confidence bound on conditional expected MFE must be strictly greater than zero in both fee-adjusted dollars and fee-adjusted return, and the equal-horizon mean calibrated conservative lower confidence bound on conditional expected profit area must be strictly greater than zero in both fee-adjusted dollar-minutes and fee-adjusted return-minutes; use every causally available registered horizon including h3 and h5; equality, missingness, or nonfinite state fails

ranking.quaternary: equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE dollars
ranking.tertiary: equal-horizon mean calibrated q10 MFE return

evidence.filter_source: FT2-04 label metadata only inside the label-side fit pipeline; the filter is never exposed to runtime composition
evidence.finite_but_censored_near_close: excluded from every empirical-CDF reference population; never treated as a shorter full horizon
evidence.finite_horizon: include hN continuous/count/CDF reference values only when censored=false, deadline_ns=entry_fill_time_ns+N*60 seconds, nominal_minutes=N, available_minutes=N, and every required mark in (entry_fill_time,deadline] is represented under the primary no-bid-as-full-loss rule
evidence.remaining_session: include continuous/count/CDF reference values only when censored=false, deadline is exact 15:55 America/New_York, and the complete registered remaining-session grid is represented
evidence.time_to_event_exception: right-censored first-profit targets are handled only by the registered discrete-survival likelihood and its censoring indicator; they do not enter continuous empirical-CDF references as finite events
